text: Sanborn's 'matrix codes... then went back to this table': a grid move and a repeating key. Every keyword grid from the dictionary was tried before, and nothing kept all 24 known letters; two hand slips would have hidden it.

Every route of experiments 110-114 and the type-1 library (1,847,590 distinct), both orders, the sculpture's 8 table classes, key lengths 1-26, up to 2 slips; K4 against 20 scrambled copies, the readings judged blind, three planted slipped messages.

With two slips the shortest key that fits K4 is 18 after the move and 16 before it (copies 16-18 and 16-17); K4 ahead of every copy in 1 cells (copies 0-3); K4's best reading scores 6, the copies' 12; the plants are found.
